definition: a field of short cut grass
description: A sunny back garden with a mown grass lawn and a tall green hedge along the back. Two fluffy dogs stand on the grass: a small cream Pomeranian and a bigger black and tan Lapphund. Between them on the lawn sits a round blue pet drinking fountain that shoots a thin jet of water straight up into the air. The dogs watch the jet, then the black and tan dog steps up to the fountain and drinks from it while the cream one circles around, jumps up and paws at the water, and the two take turns at the bowl on the grass.
